output:
{
  "harness_name": "brotli_raw_harness",
  "operations": [
    {
      "name": "encode_buffer",
      "needs_input": true,
      "summary": "Compresses a caller-provided plaintext buffer with the one-shot encoder. This is the main hot-path workload and exercises realistic match finding, histogram building, metablock construction, and bitstream emission.",
      "api_calls": [
        "BrotliEncoderMaxCompressedSize",
        "BrotliEncoderCompress",
        "BrotliEncoderVersion"
      ],
      "input_format": "Raw uncompressed bytes to be brotli-compressed; seeds/perf inputs are structured, highly repetitive text-like data with repeated records and substrings.",
      "digest": "Folds encoder success/failure, encoded size, encoder version, and a checksum over selected bytes of the produced compressed buffer."
    },
    {
      "name": "decode_buffer",
      "needs_input": true,
      "summary": "Decompresses a complete brotli payload with the one-shot decoder. Valid seeds are generated by running the library's own encoder first so the decoder processes accepted end-to-end inputs.",
      "api_calls": [
        "BrotliDecoderDecompress",
        "BrotliDecoderVersion",
        "BrotliDecoderErrorString"
      ],
      "input_format": "A valid complete brotli-compressed blob produced by this crate's encoder from deterministic structured source data.",
      "digest": "Folds decode result/error, decoded size, decoder version, and a checksum over selected bytes of the decompressed output."
    },
    {
      "name": "stream_roundtrip",
      "needs_input": true,
      "summary": "Runs streaming encode followed by streaming decode on the same payload, exercising stateful APIs, incremental I/O, take-output paths, and finished/has-more-output status checks.",
      "api_calls": [
        "BrotliEncoderCreateInstance",
        "BrotliEncoderSetParameter",
        "BrotliEncoderCompressStream",
        "BrotliEncoderHasMoreOutput",
        "BrotliEncoderTakeOutput",
        "BrotliEncoderIsFinished",
        "BrotliEncoderDestroyInstance",
        "BrotliDecoderCreateInstance",
        "BrotliDecoderSetParameter",
        "BrotliDecoderDecompressStream",
        "BrotliDecoderHasMoreOutput",
        "BrotliDecoderTakeOutput",
        "BrotliDecoderIsUsed",
        "BrotliDecoderIsFinished",
        "BrotliDecoderGetErrorCode",
        "BrotliDecoderDestroyInstance"
      ],
      "input_format": "Raw uncompressed bytes; the runner first stream-compresses them into a brotli byte stream, then stream-decompresses that stream back to plaintext.",
      "digest": "Folds encoder and decoder status codes, compressed and decompressed byte counts, finished/used flags, and checksums of both intermediate compressed bytes and final round-tripped plaintext."
    },
    {
      "name": "shared_dict_roundtrip",
      "needs_input": true,
      "summary": "Builds and attaches a prepared/shared dictionary for both encoder and decoder, then performs a dictionary-assisted compress/decompress cycle. This covers dictionary-management APIs and dictionary-aware codec paths.",
      "api_calls": [
        "BrotliEncoderPrepareDictionary",
        "BrotliEncoderGetPreparedDictionarySize",
        "BrotliEncoderCreateInstance",
        "BrotliEncoderAttachPreparedDictionary",
        "BrotliEncoderCompressStream",
        "BrotliEncoderTakeOutput",
        "BrotliEncoderDestroyPreparedDictionary",
        "BrotliEncoderDestroyInstance",
        "BrotliSharedDictionaryCreateInstance",
        "BrotliSharedDictionaryAttach",
        "BrotliDecoderCreateInstance",
        "BrotliDecoderAttachDictionary",
        "BrotliDecoderDecompressStream",
        "BrotliDecoderTakeOutput",
        "BrotliDecoderGetErrorCode",
        "BrotliSharedDictionaryDestroyInstance",
        "BrotliDecoderDestroyInstance"
      ],
      "input_format": "Raw bytes whose prefix is a small deterministic dictionary blob followed by body content intentionally containing many dictionary-reusable phrases; the harness derives the dictionary from the input itself in a deterministic way.",
      "digest": "Folds prepared-dictionary size, attach success/failure codes, stream encode/decode results, output sizes, and a checksum over the final decompressed bytes."
    }
  ],
  "seed_strategy": "For encode_buffer and stream_roundtrip, write two distinct plaintext inputs made from deterministic synthetic corpora: repeated log/JSON-like records, English words, path fragments, timestamps, and recurring templates, with one seed smaller and more repetitive and the other larger and more varied. For decode_buffer, first generate two distinct plaintext corpora as above, then call BrotliEncoderCompress to serialize them into valid brotli payloads and save those compressed bytes as the seeds. For shared_dict_roundtrip, write two distinct raw inputs whose first fixed-size region serves as the dictionary source and whose remainder reuses many phrases from that region; the runner deterministically splits input into dictionary/body. For perf data, emit large but not huge structured corpora (hundreds of KB to a few MB) using the same templates; for decode_buffer specifically, always generate the perf blob by compressing that large corpus with this crate's encoder so decode runs to completion on valid compressed input."
}
